exposure: burden and subtypes of common infections
cohort: The study included 662 children from the Copenhagen Prospective Studies on Asthma in Childhood 2010 mother-child cohort.
finding: Several risk factors of asthma-like symptoms in early childhood act through an increased infection burden in the first 3 years of life.
